metadata.participantDefinition: Uses analyzed count when provided, otherwise randomized count, otherwise enrolled; non-equivalent study denominators are identified in UI.

goals.name: Symptoms of diagnosed irritable bowel syndrome

remedies.name: Topical aloe gel in burn-care research
remedies.researchNote: Aloe leaf gel, latex, and whole-leaf extracts are distinct preparations; this record concerns topical gel.

remedies.name: Boswellia extract for knee osteoarthritis pain
searchTerms: Boswellia extract for knee osteoarthritis pain
remedies.researchNote: Boswellia serrata products are extracts of the tree’s gummy resin.

remedies.name: Topical capsaicin for knee osteoarthritis pain
searchTerms: Topical capsaicin for knee osteoarthritis pain
remedies.researchNote: Capsaicin occurs in chili peppers and is used in topical pain-relief products.

remedies.name: Colloidal oatmeal cream for itchy hand eczema
remedies.researchNote: A trial used 1% colloidal oatmeal cream four times daily for six weeks; both groups also used fluocinolone 0.025% for the first two weeks.

remedies.name: Echinacea extract for common cold prevention
searchTerms: Echinacea extract for common cold prevention
remedies.researchNote: Echinacea purpurea is one of the echinacea species used in herbal products.

remedies.name: Flaxseed for constipation
remedies.researchNote: Flaxseed, or linseed, is the ripe seed of Linum usitatissimum.

remedies.name: Ginger powder capsules for menstrual cramps
searchTerms: Ginger powder capsules for menstrual cramps
remedies.researchNote: Ginger is Zingiber officinale; its rhizome is used in food and herbal products.

remedies.name: Green kiwifruit for constipation
remedies.researchNote: Green kiwifruit is Actinidia chinensis var. deliciosa, also known in clinical literature as Actinidia deliciosa.

remedies.name: Honey for acute cough
remedies.researchNote: Honey is a bee-produced food whose composition varies with its botanical source.

remedies.name: Standardized oral lavender for anxiety symptoms
searchTerms: Standardized oral lavender for anxiety symptoms
remedies.researchNote: Silexan is a proprietary preparation produced from Lavandula angustifolia for oral clinical studies.

remedies.name: Pelargonium liquid extract for acute bronchitis symptoms
searchTerms: Pelargonium liquid extract for acute bronchitis symptoms
remedies.researchNote: Pelargonium medicinal preparations use root extracts; EMA’s monograph covers P. sidoides and P. reniforme.

remedies.name: Fixed peppermint and caraway oil for functional dyspepsia
searchTerms: Fixed peppermint and caraway oil for functional dyspepsia
remedies.researchNote: The studied intervention combines peppermint oil and caraway oil in a fixed proprietary preparation.

remedies.name: Enteric-coated peppermint oil for IBS symptoms
searchTerms: Enteric-coated peppermint oil for IBS symptoms
remedies.researchNote: Peppermint oil is extracted from Mentha × piperita leaves and flowering parts.

remedies.name: Prunes for constipation
remedies.researchNote: Prunes are dried plums from prune cultivars of Prunus domestica.

remedies.name: Psyllium husk for constipation
remedies.researchNote: Psyllium husk is the seed coat of Plantago ovata; ispaghula is another name.

remedies.name: Saline nasal irrigation for allergic rhinitis
remedies.researchNote: Nasal irrigation uses saline solution; studies used different devices, volumes, and salt concentrations.

remedies.name: Standardized senna for occasional constipation
remedies.researchNote: Senna leaf medicines use Senna alexandrina and are standardized for anthraquinone content.

remedies.name: Tea tree oil gel for mild to moderate acne
remedies.researchNote: Tea tree oil is distilled from Melaleuca alternifolia leaves.

remedies.name: Turmeric extract for knee osteoarthritis pain
searchTerms: Turmeric extract for knee osteoarthritis pain
remedies.researchNote: Turmeric contains curcuminoids, including curcumin; its underground stem is used in food and other preparations.

remedies.name: Oral zinc lozenges for common-cold duration
remedies.researchNote: Cold studies have tested oral zinc lozenges in several salt formulations, including acetate and gluconate.
